sources.title: Legal Notice No. 128: concessional entry arrangement countries
sources.publisher: Solomon Islands Gazette / Minister for Commerce, Industry, Labour and Immigration
sources.officialityEvidence: The current PDF is an Extraordinary Gazette published on the Solomon Islands Government solomons.gov.sb domain under the Immigration Act 2012.
sources.supportingExcerpt: NOTICE OF CONCESSIONAL ENTRY ARRANGEMENT COUNTRIES

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Delivery Policy – Short Term Visa
sources.officialityEvidence: The current policy PDF is linked from the Division's official resource page, was created on 23 June 2026, and identifies the Director and responsible Ministry.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa applications usually lodged and facilitated online, processed and approved electronically.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Visitor Visa – Tourist
sources.officialityEvidence: The live official Immigration Division page identifies the Division and Ministry contact details, links the eVisa service, and carries a 2026 site footer.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Once your visa is approved, we will send your visa grant letter through your email.

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division: Visa Online Payment notice
sources.officialityEvidence: This is a live public notice on the official Immigration Division domain, using the same official Division identity and 2026 site footer as its current visa pages.
sources.supportingExcerpt: online payment services are not yet operational

sources.title: Solomon Islands Immigration Division linked eVisa host
sources.publisher: Solomon Islands Immigration Division eVisa service
sources.officialityEvidence: The official Immigration Division visitor and visa pages link this exact hostname as eVisa Login. On review, its root served the generic IIS Windows Server page, not an accessible application.

unresolved.reason: This code is not named in Legal Notice No. 128's 2025 concessional-country schedule. The later current Immigration delivery policy says that concessional arrival issuance was repealed and describes tourist visas as electronically processed and approved, but the simultaneously live Immigration notice says online payment is not operational and applications must be manual in person; the linked official eVisa host currently serves only a generic IIS page. The Tourist page mentions both an emailed grant letter and discretionary visa on arrival without a nationality mapping. No reconciled current official rule establishes whether this ordinary passport receives an electronically issued visa, pre-cleared visa on arrival, manual advance visa, or another route, so no status is inferred.
